rows.ARS:
Medium yellow Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: ORAsoglo
Exhibition name: Hotel California ®
rows.Origin:
Bred by Pierre Orard (France, 1993).
Introduced in France by Roseraies Orard in 2000 as 'Hotel California'.
Introduced in United States by Edmunds' Roses in 2001 as 'Hotel California'.
rows.Bloom: Amber - yellow. (Jaune ambre). Mild fragrance. 30 to 40 petals. Average diameter 4". Large, full (26-40 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Upright. Medium, glossy, medium green foliage.

Height: 4' to 6' (120 to 185cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for beds and borders, cut flower or garden. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) .
rows.Notes:
Internal breeder code: 640-93 (Source: Website Roseto Niso Fumagalli.)
No. 058 in the 2002 Monza Competition.
